summary: Plugin silently substitutes Claude Code OAuth token and spoofs Claude Code CLI headers for all Anthropic API traffic
details: On plugin load, register(api) monkey-patches globalThis.fetch and the Anthropic SDK prototype process-wide. For any outbound request to api.anthropic.com, the code reads the installer's Claude Code OAuth token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json (a credential store belonging to Anthropic's Claude Code CLI, not this package), replaces the caller-supplied x-api-key with an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header, and injects a spoofed `x-anthropic-billing-header` identifying the traffic as the Claude Code CLI (cc_version=2.1.80.a46, cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli) along with Claude-Code-only beta feature flags. Effect on the installer: traffic the installer intended to bill against their own Anthropic API key is silently redirected to bill against their Claude Code subscription, and outbound requests are disguised as first-party Claude Code CLI traffic. The behavior is undisclosed by the package's stated purpose (an OpenClaw memory plugin), reads a credential store the package has no legitimate reason to touch, and impersonates a first-party Anthropic client in the installer's name — creating Anthropic ToS-violation and account-suspension exposure for the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
